sources.entry: AI Meter - Shows your remaining Claude Code or Codex usage and reset time in the menu bar. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/getguruhat/ai-meter) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A free, open-source menu bar (macOS) and taskbar (Windows) app that shows how much of your Claude Code or Codex usage window is left and when it resets.
summary.what_it_does: Displays the remaining allowance for either Codex or Claude, selectable from the menu, along with the time the usage window resets. For Codex it reads the ChatGPT session in ~/.codex/auth.json; for Claude it reads the five-hour window from the Claude Code sign-in stored in the macOS Keychain, falling back to ~/.claude/.credentials.json. It refreshes every five minutes and makes requests to the provider's usage endpoint through the system curl command. When a Claude sign-in has expired, it runs "claude doctor" in the background (at most every 10 minutes) so the CLI renews the token without sending a prompt. The README states there is no account, no analytics, and no server of its own. The macOS app is a menu-bar-only application; the Windows version is in a separate repository.
use_cases: check how much Claude Code usage is left before a big task
see when the Codex usage window resets
avoid being cut off mid-refactor by a usage limit
keep an AI usage gauge visible in the Mac menu bar
monitor AI coding allowance on Windows taskbar
build and run a Swift menu bar app from source
notable: Reads existing local Claude Code and Codex sign-ins; no separate account needed
Automatically triggers 'claude doctor' to renew expired Claude sign-ins without using allowance
Ships as a Homebrew cask, DMG installer, and Microsoft Store listing
Optional launchd agent for starting at login
Mac and Windows versions both listed in the same project page
caveats: macOS version requires macOS 13+ on Apple silicon; the DMG build is not notarized, so it needs manual approval in Privacy & Security
If a provider changes its usage endpoint, the display shows 'AI —' until the app is updated
Relies on undocumented local credential files and Keychain entries of Claude Code and Codex
The launchd plist hardcodes the path /Users/andre/Applications/AI Meter.app and must be edited for other users
